description: This file defines the AttributeClassDiscovery class, which implements a plugin discovery mechanism in Drupal, utilizing class reflection, attribute parsing, and file caching to locate plugin classes with specific attributes.

classes.name: AttributeClassDiscovery
classes.description: Implements plugin discovery for classes with specific attributes, using caching, reflection, and namespace analysis.

methods.name: getDefinitions
methods.description: Discovers plugin classes with attributes, utilizing file cache, class reflection, and dependency checks.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Uses reflection to parse class attributes and dependencies to generate plugin definitions.

methods.name: prepareAttributeDefinition
methods.description: Sets the class name on the attribute object.

methods.name: getTwoLevelNamespace
methods.description: Extracts the first two namespace levels from a full namespace string.

methods.name: getClassDependencies
methods.description: Retrieves class, interface, and trait dependencies of a class via reflection.

methods.name: hasMissingDependencies
methods.description: Checks if dependencies are missing based on configured root namespaces.

methods.name: getFileCacheSuffix
methods.description: Provides a suffix for cache file naming, can be extended.
